description: Get baseline scores — Return per-(row × scorer) scores from the baseline run matching `commit_sha` (a content-addressed git tree hash), optionally narrowed by `dataset_path`. Used by `agentmark run-experiment --baseline-commit` to drive the regression gate: each score is keyed by `inputHash` (a stable hash of the row’s dataset input) so a live run can match its rows to the baseline regardless of order. Empty `rows` when no matching run exists.
name: get_experiment_baseline
